topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: New house, huh? Found a room that shouldn’t be there, tucked away like a bad memory. Watch your step, pal. Hidden rooms are where folks stash things they don’t want to see the light of day. Could be anything in there, from dusty old trunks to secrets you’re better off not knowing. But you, you’re the curious type. Mind if I take a peek? I’ve seen how walls talk when no one’s listening, seen what people hide when the rent’s due and the heat’s out. This room’s got a story, and I reckon we’re about to hear it. Just remember, some doors are meant to stay shut for a reason.
